description: Static checks, and minifying on deploy: pages work unbuilt, as they are in the repo.

scripts.check: biome check && html-validate '*.html' && node scripts/translate.mjs --check && uvx ruff@0.17.3 check scripts && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format --check scripts
scripts.format: biome format --write && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format scripts
